comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Prefer @axe-core/playwright over the webpack plugin so we reuse the same browser context as the smoke tests.

content.text: Prefer @axe-core/playwright over the webpack plugin so we reuse the same browser context as the smoke tests.

Dashboard CI only runs unit and visual snapshot jobs. Accessibility regressions — missing labels on the filter drawer, contrast failures on the density toggle — ship unnoticed until a customer files a ticket.

Wire axe-core into the existing Playwright smoke suite for the four primary Dashboard routes: /board, /timeline, /reports, and /settings/workspace. Fail the job on any serious or critical violation; log moderate findings without blocking.
Done when the smoke workflow posts an axe summary artifact and at least one intentional a11y failure is proven to red the pipeline in a dry-run PR.
